//@version=6
indicator("V89 v6 requested daily counter")
f_counter(bool changed) =>
    var count = 0
    if changed
        count += 1
    count
f_observers() =>
    changed = timeframe.change("1D")
    count = f_counter(changed)
    change_value = changed ? 1.0 : 0.0
    change_missing = na(change_value) ? 1 : 0
    first_flag = barstate.isfirst ? 1 : 0
    var int first_time = na
    var int first_index = na
    var int first_isfirst = na
    var float first_change = na
    var int first_count = na
    var int first_change_missing = na
    first_evaluated = na(first_time) ? 1 : 0
    if first_evaluated == 1
        first_time := time
        first_index := bar_index
        first_isfirst := first_flag
        first_change := change_value
        first_count := count
        first_change_missing := change_missing
    [time, bar_index, first_flag, first_evaluated, change_value, count, change_missing, first_time, first_index, first_isfirst, first_change, first_count, first_change_missing]
[requested_time, requested_index, requested_isfirst, requested_first_evaluated, requested_change, requested_count, requested_change_missing, first_requested_time, first_requested_index, first_requested_isfirst, first_requested_change, first_requested_count, first_requested_change_missing] = request.security("BINANCE:BTCUSDT", "1D", f_observers(), lookahead=barmerge.lookahead_on)
plot(time, "CHART_TIME", display=display.data_window)
plot(bar_index, "CHART_BAR_INDEX", display=display.data_window)
plot(barstate.isconfirmed ? 1 : 0, "CHART_ISCONFIRMED", display=display.data_window)
plot(requested_time, "REQUEST_TIME", display=display.data_window)
plot(requested_index, "REQUEST_BAR_INDEX", display=display.data_window)
plot(requested_isfirst, "REQUEST_ISFIRST", display=display.data_window)
plot(requested_first_evaluated, "REQUEST_FIRST_EVALUATED", display=display.data_window)
plot(requested_change, "REQUEST_CHANGE", display=display.data_window)
plot(requested_count, "REQUEST_COUNTER", display=display.data_window)
plot(requested_change_missing, "REQUEST_CHANGE_IS_NA", display=display.data_window)
plot(first_requested_time, "FIRST_REQUEST_TIME", display=display.data_window)
plot(first_requested_index, "FIRST_REQUEST_BAR_INDEX", display=display.data_window)
plot(first_requested_isfirst, "FIRST_REQUEST_ISFIRST", display=display.data_window)
plot(first_requested_change, "FIRST_REQUEST_CHANGE", display=display.data_window)
plot(first_requested_count, "FIRST_REQUEST_COUNTER", display=display.data_window)
